name: Kampf dem Terror
summary:
Your army is close before capitulation. As commander in chief of the allied forces you have to make a counterattack.

This Adobe Flash based game offers simple turn-based strategical action. On the map you move your units which can be infantry, tanks, artillery, air force and naval forces. Most of them are able to attack ranged, so no automatic counterattack happens.

Different terrain types provide attack and defense bonuses. Buildings and cities can be conquered by infantry only. Conquered cities provide cash for new units, which can be bought at military facilities. In order to win either all enemy units must be destroyed or the enemy base must be liberated by infantry.

Game modes are "free game", played on a chosen map, a 10 mission campaign or a multiplayer game with online high scores.
